notes.title: Patch 1.12072025.351
notes.content:
[p]The new update has several new things. 

[/p][h2][b]3 new cards:[/b][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="149,361"][tr][th colwidth="149"][p][/p][/th][th colwidth="361"][p][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="149"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047758/f959fc4d831e7d882debe6dd88cc8acb7a2bd1b1.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="361"][p][b]Lost Wings[/b]
Gain 3 Radiance and 2 Defense Points. [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="149"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047758/278b6ac976f8c2697733d777c457a296b39a636e.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="361"][p][b]Spear of Death[/b]
Deal 5 damage and add 3 poison to the enemy[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="149"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047758/d750361d307d250e399e7a5e70139180b6e01d86.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="361"][p][b]Once Loved[/b]
Lose 3 Life Points, add rage, add 4 Strength points. [/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][h2]2 New Jewels:[/h2][p]
[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="146,366"][tr][th colwidth="146"][p][/p][/th][th colwidth="366"][p][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="146"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047758/59efce16ab9bf5e4d6f5bcaca3fce12440702b81.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="366"][p][b]Chalice[/b][/p][p]Remove poison in the 7th round, add 3 Life Points in the 3rd round and remove 1 radiance Point in the 6th round[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="146"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047758/b9ded86d87b8764e5475643fc63f99d95e32a7bb.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="366"][p][b]Mystic Eye[/b]
Remove one random card from hand in the 4th to 7th round. Add 5 max life[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]


[b]More random maps (Forest, Mountain, Fire).[/b] 


I hope you enjoy it!

I am working now on even more new features and content for Dreamians: Card Battle. 

Thank you for playing.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0. Hard mode, new achievement, more cards, Level 20.
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is Renan, game dev behind Dreamians: Card Battle. I have a few updates to share with you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047758/f3a453e75783c7493efac541b8732997c81e57c7.png"][/img][/p][p]🔥 [b]Hard Mode Unlocked![/b]
Think you've mastered Dreamians? Think again! After beating the game in Normal Mode, you can now challenge yourself with [b]Hard Mode[/b], where enemies hit harder, have more Health, and reward you with [b]bonus EXP[/b]! But beware:[/p][list][*][p][b]Rest[/b] only heals [b]10 Life Points[/b] (instead of 20).[/p][/*][*][p]No story events—just pure, unfiltered combat![/p][/*][/list][p]📈 [b]Level Cap Increased to 20![/b]
Your Dreamian can now grow even stronger! Each new level unlocks [b]special bonuses[/b], so grind your way to the top![/p][p]⚠ [b]Kalek Nerf:[/b]
Kalek’s starting max Health has been reduced from [b]70 to 50[/b]—better strategize those heals![/p][p]🏆 [b]New Steam Achievement:[/b]
Prove your skills by [b]finishing the game on Hard Mode[/b] and claim your bragging rights![/p][p][/p][p][b]Two new cards:[/b] [/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="130,"][tr][th colwidth="130"][p]Card[/p][/th][th][p]Description[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="130"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047758/c3ed943e07db9bd182032f770d0d200da6364b14.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/td][td][p][/p][p][b]Time Sword:[/b] 8 damage. +1 Radiance. -1 Life. Send it to limbo after use. [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="130"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047758/563297601b5452e0748252dbea4aee9e8df7a704.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][b]Cosmic Fate:[/b] 10 damage all enemies. Send it to limbo after use. [/p][/td][/tr][/table][table equalcells="1" colwidth="131,"][tr][td colwidth="131"][p][/p][/td][td][p][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][p]🔧 [b]Other Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]UI tweaks[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map fixes[/b] to polish your adventure.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat balance adjustments[/b] for fairer (but still tough!) battles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gallery updates[/b]—check out the new additions![/p][/*][/list][p]Time to dive back in and test your limits! Will you conquer [b]Hard Mode[/b]? 💪[/p][p][i]Update available now on Steam![/i] 🚀[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for you support. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Renan[/b][/p][p]Game Dev[/p][p]White Vortex[/p][p][/p][p][/p]
